text: {"type_map": {}, "constraints": [{"id": "R1", "category": "protocol", "alternatives": ["(df['PROTOCOL'] != 6) | (df['TCP_FLAGS'] == df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS'] + df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS'])", "(df['PROTOCOL'] != 6) | (df['TCP_FLAGS'] == (df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS'] | df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS']))"], "features": ["PROTOCOL", "TCP_FLAGS", "CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS", "SERVER_TCP_FLAGS"], "rationale": "For TCP flows the cumulative TCP flags must equal the combination of client and server flags; for non-TCP flows all flag fields must be zero."}, {"id": "R2", "category": "protocol", "alternatives": ["(df['PROTOCOL'] != 6) | (df['TCP_FLAGS'] > 0)"], "features": ["PROTOCOL", "TCP_FLAGS"], "rationale": "Any valid TCP flow must have at least one TCP flag set (SYN, ACK, FIN, etc.), so TCP_FLAGS must be non-zero for TCP."}, {"id": "R3", "category": "protocol", "alternatives": ["(df['PROTOCOL'] != 6) | (df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS'] > 0)", "(df['PROTOCOL'] != 6) | (df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS'] > 0)"], "features": ["PROTOCOL", "CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS", "SERVER_TCP_FLAGS"], "rationale": "In a TCP flow both the client and server sides must send at least one segment carrying TCP flags, so each directional flag field should be non-zero."}, {"id": "R4", "category": "protocol", "alternatives": ["(df['PROTOCOL'] != 6) | ((df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS'] == 0))"], "features": ["PROTOCOL", "RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES", "RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS", "RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES", "RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS"], "rationale": "Retransmission is a TCP-specific mechanism; for non-TCP protocols all retransmitted byte and packet counts must be zero."}, {"id": "R5", "category": "protocol", "alternatives": ["(df['PROTOCOL'] != 6) | ((df['TCP_WIN_MAX_IN'] == 0) & (df['TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT'] == 0))"], "features": ["PROTOCOL", "TCP_WIN_MAX_IN", "TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT"], "rationale": "TCP window size is a TCP-specific field; for non-TCP protocols both max window values must be zero."}, {"id": "R6", "category": "protocol", "alternatives": ["(df['PROTOCOL'] != 1) | (df['ICMP_TYPE'] // 256 == df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE'])"], "features": ["PROTOCOL", "ICMP_TYPE", "ICMP_IPV4_TYPE"], "rationale": "ICMP_TYPE is defined as ICMP_Type * 256 + ICMP_code, so for ICMP flows the integer division by 256 must recover the ICMP type byte."}, {"id": "R7", "category": "protocol", "alternatives": ["(df['PROTOCOL'] != 1) | ((df['ICMP_TYPE'] == 0) & (df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE'] == 0))"], "features": ["PROTOCOL", "ICMP_TYPE", "ICMP_IPV4_TYPE"], "rationale": "ICMP-specific fields must be zero for all non-ICMP protocols."}, {"id": "R8", "category": "protocol", "alternatives": ["(df['PROTOCOL'] != 1) | (df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE'] > 0)"], "features": ["PROTOCOL", "ICMP_IPV4_TYPE"], "rationale": "For ICMP flows the ICMP type byte must be non-zero (valid ICMP types are 0-19, none of which is 0 in practice for observed flows, but at minimum the field should be populated)."}]}
